Release checklist for onedevr

Source: RELEASE.md

Use this when cutting a GitHub Release (Phase 4+).

  1. Ensure main is green on R-CMD-check.
  2. Confirm DESCRIPTION Version matches the tag (e.g. 0.1.0 → v0.1.0).
  3. Update NEWS.md for the release.
  4. Tag and publish:
git checkout main
git pull
gh release create v0.1.0 --title "onedevr 0.1.0" --notes-file NEWS.md
  1. Confirm the pkgdown workflow deployed to https://alexseymer.github.io/onedevR/
  2. In GitHub repo Settings → Pages, set source to the gh-pages branch (first deploy creates it) if not already configured.

CRAN submission remains optional; the package name onedevr was available on CRAN as of the Phase 4 check (2026-08-02).

Developed by Alex Seymer.
